selections: Instantaneous, inside the field grid, uz ≥ 1, positive weights. Beam/energetic curves have no radius cut.
central: Geometric phase-space selection only; not a trapping test.
statistics: Charge weighted, centred population moments; normalised emittance uses x and ux (or y and uy).
duplicate_ids: All physical records retained for distributions. Histories require unique IDs.
maximum: Maximum over all saved forward inside-grid electrons; identity may change.
